page_title: BAR 7-1 VAL | Barcelona v Valencia 26/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' Pepelu (Valencia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90' We will have 2 min. of added time.

88' A neat pass finds Pablo Torre (Barcelona) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the bottom left corner, but Giorgi Mamardashvili denies him with a good save.
87' Some patient build-up play from Valencia as they look to unlock the defence.
85' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 10:2.
83' Carlos Corberan prepares a substitution. Dimitri Foulquier is replaced by Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia).
82' Substitution. Iker Cordoba (Valencia) has come on for Yarek Gasiorowski.
82' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes well wide of the left post.
80' Fran Perez (Valencia) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pablo Torre (Barcelona) will replace Frenkie de Jong.
78' Yarek Gasiorowski (Valencia) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar.
77' The resulting corner from Pepelu (Valencia) is cleared.
75' 7 - 1 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Cesar Tarrega (Valencia), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 7:1.
74' The attendance for today's match is 45312.
73' Valencia have a goal ruled out for offside!

73' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Giorgi Mamardashvili guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
71' Hansi Flick decides to make a substitution. Jules Kounde will be replaced by Hector Fort (Barcelona).
71' A substitution has been made. Lamine Yamal goes off and Pau Victor (Barcelona) comes on.
70' Cesar Soto Grado has issued a yellow card to Pepelu (Valencia).
69' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
66' 6 - 1 Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom left corner. Magnificent finish!
64' The ratio of the ball possession is 76:24.
62' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fran Perez (Valencia) replaces Diego Lopez.
60' We are about to witness a subsitution. Maximillian Aarons (Valencia) for Andre Almeida.
60' Substitution. Jose Gaya makes his way off the pitch and Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) comes on as his replacement.
60' Hansi Flick has decided to make a change. Gerard Martin (Barcelona) replaces Alejandro Balde.
60' A substitution has been made. Raphinha is replaced by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona).
59' 5 - 1 Hugo Duro (Valencia) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect strike that goes inside the top left corner.
58' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
58' Barcelona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
57' Barcelona will take a corner kick.
57' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Raphinha (Barcelona).
56' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Valencia was in an offside position.
55' CHANCE! Ferran Torres (Barcelona) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar.
54' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
52' Marc Casado (Barcelona) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
50' Yarek Gasiorowski (Valencia) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
48' Barcelona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
48' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Raphinha (Barcelona). The referee points to the corner flag and Barcelona will take a corner.
47' Luis Rioja (Valencia) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' 5 - 0 Goal! Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 5:0.
45+4' Raphinha (Barcelona) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar.
45+2' One of the Valencia players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
44' Raphinha (Barcelona) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
44' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Good work from Barcelona as they win a corner.
42' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Raphinha (Barcelona). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
41' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Barcelona earn a corner.
40' Luis Rioja (Valencia) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
39' The resulting set piece from Barcelona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
39' Barcelona take a short corner kick.
38' The ball is out of play. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner.
38' The resulting set piece from Raphinha (Barcelona) is successfully intercepted by the defender. Barcelona force a corner. They send men into the box.
35' Here comes the VAR decision. Referee Cesar Soto Grado decides there was no infringement by Wojciech Szczesny (Barcelona) and the game can continue.
35' The Valencia players are stunned as referee Cesar Soto Grado changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
34' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Valencia using VAR. Let's see what happens.
33' Wojciech Szczesny (Barcelona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Soto Grado had an easy-decision to make.

33' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Wojciech Szczesny (Barcelona). Cesar Soto Grado saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. The advantage of a penalty kick is given to Valencia.
30' Corner kick. Raphinha (Barcelona) is ready to send the ball into the box.
29' Total attempts – 8:1.
27' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just wide of the right post from inside the box.
26' Corner kick. Barcelona will have an opportunity.
25' 4 - 0 Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and slams the ball into the top right corner. What a special shot.
25' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Cesar Soto Grado signals that there was no handball and the goal stands! The Barcelona players celebrate.
24' Barcelona score a goal, but the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
24' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
22' Andre Almeida (Valencia) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
21' Luis Rioja (Valencia) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
20' Luis Rioja (Valencia) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Valencia have been awarded a corner kick.
19' A quickly taken corner by Barcelona.
18' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
16' 79:21 – the latest ball possession ratio.
14' 3 - 0 Raphinha (Barcelona) gets one-on-one with the goalkeeper and takes an early shot which finds the back of the net.
12' Luis Rioja (Valencia) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
12' Valencia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The linesman makes the right call and Valencia will have a corner.

11' Pepelu (Valencia) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall. The ball goes behind for a corner. Valencia will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

10' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Cesar Soto Grado stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Valencia win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
8' 2 - 0 Ferran Torres (Barcelona) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and fires the ball inside the right post. What a wonderful strike!
6' Barcelona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
5' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Raphinha (Barcelona) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.

3' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Lamine Yamal. The score is now 1:0.
1' The first half has started.
Barcelona will kick-off.
Cesar Soto Grado will supervise the game today.
